subject: System Design
title: Modular Monoliths
description: A quick win: understand Modular Monoliths.

hook.text: What if a monolith had clear internal boundaries? Each module owns its code and data, but they deploy together.

buildup.text: A modular monolith enforces boundaries between modules while keeping the simplicity of a single deployment.

discovery.text: Shopify runs a modular monolith. Strict module boundaries let hundreds of developers work independently.

twist.text: Enforcing module boundaries in a monolith requires discipline. Without tooling, boundaries erode over time.

climax.text: The modular monolith gives you microservice-like modularity without the distributed system complexity.

punchline.text: Enforce boundaries within the monolith — best of both worlds.

quiz.question: What is a modular monolith?
options: A monolith with enforced internal boundaries between modules
